reason: The auger is the only offered action and seems suited to opening the resource ice for a well.
expectation: I expect it to drill into the ice, preparing an extraction point.

effect: The borehole gives the lance a place to reach the ice.
reaction: The result matched my expectation, though it was terse.
reason: The heating lance is the only offered combination and should melt ice in the borehole.
expectation: I expect a heated well or meltwater source.

effect: The well is heated, so I can now connect a way to move its water.
reaction: A logical progression, though again the result gives little detail.
reason: The hose is the only offered combination and should connect the well to the treatment plant.
expectation: I expect a connected water supply, perhaps requiring another step to reach the processor.

effect: The sealed line already reaches the processor, completing the transport goal; the water still needs treatment.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the well connected to the cabin, though the description is fairly functional.
reason: The cloth is the only offered action and should remove grit before further treatment.
expectation: I expect filtered well water, still containing dissolved salts as the earlier test showed.

effect: The water is clarified but has not yet been made potable, so the processor is next.
reaction: This follows the previous test naturally; I am curious how the processor handles the dissolved material.
reason: The processor is the only offered combination and is needed to make a potable supply.
expectation: I expect treated drinking water and possibly an explanation of the treatment.

effect: The processor produces drinking water and completes the supply, though I still do not know how it removes dissolved salts.
reaction: The nearly tasteless first cup is a pleasing, concrete payoff after the construction.

mostWorthwhile.text: The first cup gives the practical construction a vivid human payoff; its almost absent taste makes the transformation feel real.

leastWorthwhile.text: The borehole and heated well results are terse and the mandatory sequence offers no actual choice, so those actions felt more like following instructions than solving a problem.

surprise.text: The first cup tasting of almost nothing was a nice detail; I had expected an explanation of the treatment instead.

arbitrary.text: No action lacked an obvious purpose, though connecting cloth to the well line gives little detail about how filtration is arranged.

continue.text: I would continue for the larger story and tangible payoff, but I hope for more meaningful choices and detail about how the equipment works.
